rule.description: Confirm mode: enter LONG when price↑ + OI↑ both at extreme z; SHORT when price↓ + OI↓ both at extreme z. Hold 24×5min=2h, SL 2%, fee 0.04%.

data_source.data_freshness: joblib needs daily refresh OR forward-collect via fetch_binance_metrics.py daily cron

implementation_required.source_class: BinanceOIPriceDecouplingSource (NEW) — load close + open_interest 5m, compute joint z-score, emit signal {-1,0,+1}
implementation_required.policy: LongShortThresholdPolicy (existing) with entry=0.5, sl=0.02, tp=1.0, max_hold=24
implementation_required.session_cli_runtime: load OI joblib + close 5m + bundle inject (similar to bn_funding_dispersion pattern)
implementation_required.milestone_check_baseline: Add to BASELINE_METRICS dict in scripts/milestone_check.py

user_approval_rationale: Hard cutoff 1/5 strict (alpha 97%, sharpe 87%, wr 99% borderline). Robustness 3/4. Same gate score as autocorr_regime/funding_carry path which also required user explicit approval. Seeding decision is user's per research_track_master.md §5-B.
